data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 were GBP 612.8m. During 2016 the Syndicate recorded prior-year favourable development, with reported releases from prior accident years of GBP 40.3m (reported in the technical provisions note). This prior-year improvement reduced overall claims reserves and contributed to the 2016 net technical result. The releases were described as portfolio-wide favourable development rather than being driven by a single event; 2016 did see a number of natural catastrophe and loss events (Alberta wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, Louisiana floods, Jubilee field loss offshore Ghana and the Brussels airport attack) but the report states none had a material impact on the Syndicate's reserves.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development: the report explicitly states 'GBP 40.3m ... of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years' but does not unambiguously label this amount as gross or net. A gross prior-year movement figure (insurance liabilities column) was not explicitly found elsewhere; therefore the stated GBP 40.3m release (used above) is taken from the technical provisions narrative (treated as the prior-year movement). If a strictly gross figure is required, the gross movement note/triangle would need detailed reconciliation - fall-back used here is the explicit narrative amount (confidence <1.0).
